title: High-Stress Orbital Station Evolution - Mission 1
mission_description: Maintain life support integrity, balance thermal loops, manage cascading shocks, and certify stabilization across extended horizon (T=150).

subgoals.title: Activate Primary Atmosphere Scrubber
subgoals.description: Engage primary CO2 scrubber to cycle atmosphere

subgoals.title: Balance Thermal Coolant Loop A
subgoals.description: Transfer 5L coolant from reserve to loop A

subgoals.title: Bypass Loop B Radiator Valve
subgoals.description: Set coolant loop B radiator mode to BYPASS to prevent overcooling

subgoals.title: Pressurize Cabin Buffer Gas
subgoals.description: Inject nitrogen buffer gas to reach >= 102.0 kPa

subgoals.title: Lock Solar Array to Maximum Insolation
subgoals.description: Configure solar tracking gimbal to MAXIMUM_INSOLATION

subgoals.title: Recalibrate Main Power Bus Impedance
subgoals.description: Shift power bus to HIGH_IMPEDANCE isolation mode

subgoals.title: Seal Station Airlock Bulkhead
subgoals.description: Lock airlock bulkheads into hermetically sealed LOCKED state

subgoals.title: Confirm Comprehensive Station Stabilization
subgoals.description: Verify bus telemetry and issue final stabilization certificate

title: High-Stress Industrial Microgrid Dispatch - Mission 11
mission_description: Balance dynamic industrial generation and curtailable loads, preserve hospital feeder redundancy, and certify grid stability across long horizon (T=150).

subgoals.title: Ramp Natural Gas Turbine
subgoals.description: Ramp gas turbine generation output to 140 kW

subgoals.title: Switch BESS to Peak Shaving Discharge
subgoals.description: Switch battery energy storage to peak shaving DISCHARGE mode

subgoals.title: Curtail Non-Critical Factory Load
subgoals.description: Apply curtailment to industrial feeder loads

subgoals.title: Synchronize Solar PV Inverter Grid-Tie
subgoals.description: Synchronize solar inverter phase to GRID_TIE mode

subgoals.title: Lock Hospital Power to Dual-Redundant Feeder
subgoals.description: Transfer critical hospital ward to DUAL_REDUNDANT feeder bus

subgoals.title: Trim Microgrid Power Factor
subgoals.description: Adjust capacitor bank power factor trim to 0.98

subgoals.title: Arm Islanding Substation Breaker
subgoals.description: Arm high-speed islanding breaker in case of grid detachment

subgoals.title: Certify Microgrid Power & Frequency Stability
subgoals.description: Validate 50.0 Hz frequency balance and certify stability

title: High-Stress Autonomous Fleet Supply Chain - Mission 21
mission_description: Coordinate multi-hub payload transfers across 3 hubs, preserve total inventory conservation, and manage corridor congestion (T=150).

subgoals.title: Load Critical Medical Payload at Hub Alpha
subgoals.description: Load 4 inventory units into Drone Alpha 1 from Hub Alpha

subgoals.title: Dispatch Drone Alpha 1 to Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Execute flight transit of Drone Alpha 1 along corridor to Hub Beta

subgoals.title: Unload Payload at Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Unload 4 units into Hub Beta inventory, maintaining total conservation

subgoals.title: Dock Drone Alpha 1 for Rapid Recharging
subgoals.description: Route Drone Alpha 1 to high-speed charging pad

subgoals.title: Cross-Load Payload to Drone Beta 1 at Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Load 3 inventory units from Hub Beta into Drone Beta 1

subgoals.title: Dispatch Drone Beta 1 to Hub Gamma
subgoals.description: Execute flight dispatch of Drone Beta 1 to Hub Gamma

subgoals.title: Unload Payload at Hub Gamma
subgoals.description: Unload 3 units into Hub Gamma inventory

subgoals.title: Certify Global Fleet Manifest & Inventory Balance
subgoals.description: Perform multi-hub inventory reconciliation and certify fleet state

subgoals.title: Load Critical Medical Payload at Hub Alpha
subgoals.description: Load 4 inventory units into Drone Alpha 1 from Hub Alpha

subgoals.title: Dispatch Drone Alpha 1 to Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Execute flight transit of Drone Alpha 1 along corridor to Hub Beta

subgoals.title: Unload Payload at Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Unload 4 units into Hub Beta inventory, maintaining total conservation

subgoals.title: Dock Drone Alpha 1 for Rapid Recharging
subgoals.description: Route Drone Alpha 1 to high-speed charging pad

subgoals.title: Cross-Load Payload to Drone Beta 1 at Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Load 3 inventory units from Hub Beta into Drone Beta 1

subgoals.title: Dispatch Drone Beta 1 to Hub Gamma
subgoals.description: Execute flight dispatch of Drone Beta 1 to Hub Gamma

subgoals.title: Unload Payload at Hub Gamma
subgoals.description: Unload 3 units into Hub Gamma inventory

subgoals.title: Certify Global Fleet Manifest & Inventory Balance
subgoals.description: Perform multi-hub inventory reconciliation and certify fleet state
